method: Read-only research on 2026-09-09. Sources: case-study/history/CHRONOLOGY.md (the 'Relationships that the sources support' list was the starting hypothesis set), case-study/history/TOOLS-MANIFEST.json (tool ids, resources_created/resources_reused), compound-design/SOURCES.md, NOTICE, compound-design/registry/resource-registry.json (provenance / upstream / supersedes / supersededBy per resource), compound-design/learning/LEDGER.md, docs/solutions, docs/frames, docs/plans, compound-design/releases/*.md, compound-design/research/*.md, compound-design/quality/e2 (RESOURCE-MANIFEST.json, CANDIDATE-LANE.md, releases/), case-study/design-benchmark/rubric and case-study/scripts, git history of compoundmetrics (main + case-study branch) and of the readable repositories under .research/history/ (studio-dev-ui, supernova-catalogo incl. branch compound-design-framework, processo, geistlabsds, studio-ds, design-engineering-guide) and /home/user/compound-labs-design. Where two repositories were claimed to share a file, the files were compared by md5 at the named commits. Rule applied: an edge is verified:true only when a file path + line, a commit, or a quoted string shows it; anything the brief or the chronology implies without such a source is verified:false with the reason, or listed under none_verified. External nodes carry only 'informed' edges; where the only attribution is a commit subject rather than an attribution file, the edge says so in its note. Third-party upstreams outside the brief's external list (Canvas UI, React Bits, Supernova tokens, Iconiq, tweakcn, shadcn registry-template) are modelled as resources labelled third-party so that their 'reused' edges keep their evidence. No network, no model runtime, no state-changing git command. Nothing was inferred from plausibility.
